skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop a comprehensive understanding of system design principles and methodologies.
Apply project management techniques to oversee the development of information systems.
Analyze user requirements to design effective information management systems.
Understand and apply IT governance principles in managing information systems.
Conduct thorough analysis of existing systems to identify areas for improvement.
Implement software engineering practices in developing information management systems.
Create accurate data models for information management systems.
Plan and organize projects related to information management systems development.
